```{r setup, include=FALSE}
  "rmarkdown", "knitr", "htmltools", "dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "forcats",

)

                                               logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

  stop("Install the required R packages before knitting: ",
       paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

  stop("Place the raw CSV beside this Rmd, or set params$data_file: ", params$data_file)
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%",
```

<!-- All analysis code is embedded below. Knitting refits every model; no saved result files are required. -->

```{r compute-preprocessing, include=FALSE}
shared <- local({
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr); library(forcats);
library(ggplot2); library(scales); library(lubridate);
library(caret); library(ranger); library(knitr)
})
set.seed(5003)
# ---- dataset-scope ----
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# The CSV is stored in the same folder as this R Markdown file.
data <- read.csv(
  params$data_file,
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)

# Restrict the scope to cats and dogs and consolidate the 28 raw outcomes.
data_selected <- data %>%
  filter(Type %in% c("Dog", "Puppy", "Cat", "Kitten")) %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome.Group = case_when(
      str_detect(Outcome.Status, regex("Adopt", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Adoption",
      str_detect(Outcome.Status, regex("Transfer", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Transfer",
      str_detect(Outcome.Status, regex("Euthan", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Euthanasia",
      str_detect(
        Outcome.Status,
        regex("Reclaim|Redemption|Returned To Owner|Return to Habitat", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Return",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Outcome.Group = factor(
      Outcome.Group,
      levels = c("Adoption", "Transfer", "Return", "Euthanasia", "Other")
    )
  )

group_summary <- data_selected %>%
  count(Outcome.Group, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = 100 * Count / sum(Count),
    Outcome.Group = factor(Outcome.Group, levels = levels(data_selected$Outcome.Group))
  )

key_missing <- c(
  "Name", "Euthanasia.Reason", "Secondary.Color",
  "Date.of.Birth", "Spayed.Neutered"
)

missing_summary <- tibble(
  Feature = key_missing,
  Missing_Pct = sapply(
    key_missing,
    function(feature) {
      values <- data_selected[[feature]]
      100 * mean(is.na(values) | trimws(as.character(values)) == "")
    }
  )
) %>%
  arrange(Missing_Pct) %>%
  mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels = Feature))



# ---- eda-data-quality ----
library(lubridate)

# EDA audit helpers: inspect blanks and read date strings without changing the source.
is_blank <- function(x) {
  is.na(x) | trimws(as.character(x)) == ""
}

parse_shelter_date <- function(x) {
  as.Date(parse_date_time(
    as.character(x),
    orders = c("Y b d I M S p", "ymd HMS", "mdy HMS", "dmy HMS",
               "ymd", "mdy", "dmy"),
    locale = "C", tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE
  ))
}

# Keep this copy unchanged throughout EDA.
data_eda <- data_selected

# age check
age_audit <- tibble(
  DOB = parse_shelter_date(data_eda$Date.of.Birth),
  Intake_Date = parse_shelter_date(data_eda$Intake.Date)
) %>%
  mutate(Age_Years_raw = as.numeric(Intake_Date - DOB) / 365)

quality_features <- c(
  "Type", "Sex", "Spayed.Neutered", "Primary.Breed",
  "Primary.Color", "Secondary.Color", "Name", "Date.of.Birth", "Intake.Date"
)
quality_summary <- tibble(
  Feature = quality_features,
  Distinct_nonblank = sapply(quality_features, function(v) {
    x <- as.character(data_eda[[v]])
    n_distinct(x[!is_blank(x)])
  }),
  Missing_n = sapply(quality_features, function(v) sum(is_blank(data_eda[[v]]))),
  Missing_pct = 100 * Missing_n / nrow(data_eda),
  Unknown_label_n = sapply(quality_features, function(v) {
    sum(str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(data_eda[[v]]))) == "unknown",
        na.rm = TRUE)
  })
)


quality_checks <- tibble(
  Check = c("Records", "Distinct nonmissing Animal IDs", "Exact duplicate rows",
            "Animal IDs with more than one record", "Missing Animal IDs",
            "Nonblank birth dates that failed parsing",
            "Nonblank intake dates that failed parsing",
            "Age unavailable from dates", "Negative ages observed"),
  Count = c(
    nrow(data_eda),
    n_distinct(data_eda$Animal.ID[!is_blank(data_eda$Animal.ID)]),
    sum(duplicated(data_eda)),
    sum(table(data_eda$Animal.ID[!is_blank(data_eda$Animal.ID)]) > 1),
    sum(is_blank(data_eda$Animal.ID)),
    sum(!is_blank(data_eda$Date.of.Birth) & is.na(age_audit$DOB)),
    sum(!is_blank(data_eda$Intake.Date) & is.na(age_audit$Intake_Date)),
    sum(is.na(age_audit$Age_Years_raw)),
    sum(age_audit$Age_Years_raw < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)



# ---- latest-intake-record ----
# Preprocessing 1. Retain one record per animal: its latest recorded intake.
# Keep the source row order so tied intake timestamps have a fixed rule.
data_latest <- data_selected %>%
  mutate(
    .source_row = row_number(),
    Intake_Datetime = parse_date_time(
      as.character(Intake.Date),
      orders = c("Y b d I M S p", "ymd HMS", "mdy HMS", "dmy HMS",
                 "ymd", "mdy", "dmy"),
      locale = "C", tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE
    )
  )

data_latest <- data_latest %>%
  # Sort each animal's records from newest to oldest.
  # For equal timestamps, the first row in the source file comes first.
  arrange(Animal.ID, desc(Intake_Datetime), .source_row) %>%
  group_by(Animal.ID) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Restore source order and remove the temporary selection columns.
  arrange(.source_row) %>%
  select(-.source_row, -Intake_Datetime)


# ---- fixed-model-features ----
# Preprocessing 2-6. Construct model features from the retained latest-intake records.
prepare_features <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      # 2. Type-Age redundancy: Type now contains species only.
      Type_original = as.character(Type),
      Type = factor(case_when(
        Type_original %in% c("Dog", "Puppy") ~ "Dog",
        Type_original %in% c("Cat", "Kitten") ~ "Cat",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ), levels = c("Cat", "Dog")),

      # 3. Age at intake: this is the first conversion of negative ages to NA.
      DOB = parse_shelter_date(Date.of.Birth),
      Intake_Date = parse_shelter_date(Intake.Date),
      Age_Years_raw = as.numeric(Intake_Date - DOB) / 365,
      Age_Years = if_else(Age_Years_raw < 0, NA_real_, Age_Years_raw),

      # 4. Name: treat blanks and case-insensitive placeholders as not recorded.
      has_Name = factor(if_else(
        is_blank(Name) | str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(Name))) %in%
          c("unknown", "*", "n/a", "na"), "0", "1"
      ), levels = c("0", "1")),

      # 5. Sex / Spayed.Neutered: standardise spelling, case and missing values.
      Sex = factor(case_when(
        str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(Sex))) == "male" ~ "Male",
        str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(Sex))) == "female" ~ "Female",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ), levels = c("Female", "Male", "Unknown")),
      Spayed.Neutered = factor(case_when(
        str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(Spayed.Neutered))) == "yes" ~ "Yes",
        str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(Spayed.Neutered))) == "no" ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ), levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")),

      # 6. Breed / Colour: fixed text cleaning; frequency grouping is deferred.
      Primary.Breed = if_else(is_blank(Primary.Breed), "Unknown",
                              trimws(as.character(Primary.Breed))),
      Base_Color = factor(case_when(
        is_blank(Primary.Color) ~ "Unknown",
        str_detect(Primary.Color, regex("brown|tan|choc|fawn|buff|sable|liver|cinnamon|rust|agouti|bronze|chestnut|sandy|seal", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Brown/Tan",
        str_detect(Primary.Color, regex("black|charcoal|sooty", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Black",
        str_detect(Primary.Color, regex("white|cream|blonde|albino|champagne|wheat|snow", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "White/Cream",
        str_detect(Primary.Color, regex("blue|grey|gray|silver|lilac|wolf", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Blue/Grey",
        str_detect(Primary.Color, regex("orange|red|ginger|yellow|gold|apricot|lemon|flame", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Orange/Red",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )),
      has_pattern = factor(case_when(
        !is_blank(Secondary.Color) |
          coalesce(str_detect(Primary.Color, regex(
            "tabby|brindle|smoke|point|calico|torbie|tort|tri|merle|tiger|ticked|lynx|roan|bicolor|patch|shaded",
            ignore_case = TRUE
          )), FALSE) ~ "Mixed",
        is_blank(Primary.Color) ~ "Unknown",
        TRUE ~ "Pure"
      ), levels = c("Pure", "Mixed", "Unknown"))
    )
}

data_features <- prepare_features(data_latest)

# ---- shared-data-split ----
# Preprocessing 7. Shared 80/20 split and 5 CV folds using caret.
library(caret)
set.seed(5003)

# createDataPartition returns the training row numbers, stratified by outcome.
train_index <- createDataPartition(
  data_features$Outcome.Group,
  p = 0.8,
  list = FALSE
)
train_raw <- data_features[train_index, ]
test_raw <- data_features[-train_index, ]
y_train <- train_raw$Outcome.Group
y_test <- test_raw$Outcome.Group

# Each list element contains the validation row numbers within train_raw.
cv_folds <- createFolds(
  y_train,
  k = 5,
  list = TRUE,
  returnTrain = FALSE
)

# ---- common-train-test-preprocessing ----
# 8. Learn species-specific age medians from training only.
overall_age_median <- median(train_raw$Age_Years, na.rm = TRUE)
age_medians <- train_raw %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(Age_Median = median(Age_Years, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 9. Select the eight most common recorded breeds in training.
top8_breeds <- train_raw %>%
  filter(Primary.Breed != "Unknown") %>%
  count(Primary.Breed, name = "Count") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count), Primary.Breed) %>%
  filter(row_number() <= 8) %>%
  pull(Primary.Breed)

# 10. Keep these eight predictors in x_train/x_test; y_train/y_test hold the outcome.
model_predictors <- c(
  "Type", "Sex", "Spayed.Neutered", "primary.breed.group",
  "Base_Color", "has_pattern", "has_Name", "Age_Years_imputed"
)
factor_predictors <- setdiff(model_predictors, "Age_Years_imputed")

# Apply steps 8-10 to training: fill missing ages and group breeds.
# Use the overall training median only if a species median is unavailable.
x_train <- train_raw %>%
  left_join(age_medians, by = "Type") %>%
  mutate(
    Age_Years_imputed = case_when(
      !is.na(Age_Years) ~ Age_Years,
      !is.na(Age_Median) ~ Age_Median,
      TRUE ~ overall_age_median
    ),
    primary.breed.group = if_else(
      Primary.Breed %in% top8_breeds, Primary.Breed, "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(model_predictors))

# Apply the same training medians and breed list to the test data.
x_test <- test_raw %>%
  left_join(age_medians, by = "Type") %>%
  mutate(
    Age_Years_imputed = case_when(
      !is.na(Age_Years) ~ Age_Years,
      !is.na(Age_Median) ~ Age_Median,
      TRUE ~ overall_age_median
    ),
    primary.breed.group = if_else(
      Primary.Breed %in% top8_breeds, Primary.Breed, "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(model_predictors))

# Use the same factor levels in training and test data.
for (variable in factor_predictors) {
  x_train[[variable]] <- factor(x_train[[variable]])
  x_test[[variable]] <- factor(
    x_test[[variable]],
    levels = levels(x_train[[variable]])
  )
}


# ---- common-cv-preprocessing ----
# Repeat steps 8-10 within each fold, starting from data before imputation.
# Learn the rules from fold_train only, then apply them to fold_valid.
cv_data <- list()
for (k in 1:5) {
  fold_train <- train_raw[-cv_folds[[k]], ]
  fold_valid <- train_raw[cv_folds[[k]], ]

  # 8. Age medians from this fold's training data.
  fold_overall_median <- median(fold_train$Age_Years, na.rm = TRUE)
  fold_age_medians <- fold_train %>%
    group_by(Type) %>%
    summarise(Age_Median = median(Age_Years, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # 9. Top eight breeds from this fold's training data.
  fold_top8_breeds <- fold_train %>%
    filter(Primary.Breed != "Unknown") %>%
    count(Primary.Breed, name = "Count") %>%
    arrange(desc(Count), Primary.Breed) %>%
    filter(row_number() <= 8) %>%
    pull(Primary.Breed)

  # 8-10. Apply the rules and keep the common predictors.
  fold_train <- fold_train %>%
    left_join(fold_age_medians, by = "Type") %>%
    mutate(
      Age_Years_imputed = case_when(
        !is.na(Age_Years) ~ Age_Years,
        !is.na(Age_Median) ~ Age_Median,
        TRUE ~ fold_overall_median
      ),
      primary.breed.group = if_else(
        Primary.Breed %in% fold_top8_breeds, Primary.Breed, "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Outcome.Group, all_of(model_predictors))

  fold_valid <- fold_valid %>%
    left_join(fold_age_medians, by = "Type") %>%
    mutate(
      Age_Years_imputed = case_when(
        !is.na(Age_Years) ~ Age_Years,
        !is.na(Age_Median) ~ Age_Median,
        TRUE ~ fold_overall_median
      ),
      primary.breed.group = if_else(
        Primary.Breed %in% fold_top8_breeds, Primary.Breed, "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Outcome.Group, all_of(model_predictors))

  # 10. Use this fold's training factor levels for validation.
  for (variable in factor_predictors) {
    fold_train[[variable]] <- factor(fold_train[[variable]])
    fold_valid[[variable]] <- factor(
      fold_valid[[variable]],
      levels = levels(fold_train[[variable]])
    )
  }

  cv_data[[k]] <- list(
    x_train = select(fold_train, all_of(model_predictors)),
    y_train = fold_train$Outcome.Group,
    x_valid = select(fold_valid, all_of(model_predictors)),
    y_valid = fold_valid$Outcome.Group
  )
}

# Each cv_data[[k]] contains x_train, y_train, x_valid and y_valid.
# Validation data stay separate from the final x_test/y_test holdout.
# cv_folds[[k]] identifies the validation rows for out-of-fold predictions.
# This block prepares common data; model fitting/scoring belongs in each model section.

# Variable	Description
# x_train	Preprocessed predictors for the full training set (80%).
# y_train	Outcome labels for the full training set.
# x_test	Test predictors processed using the training-derived rules (20%).
# y_test	Outcome labels for final test evaluation.
# 5-fold CV : cv_data
  rng_state <- .Random.seed
  environment()
})
# Expose shared summaries to the narrative and plots.
list2env(as.list(shared, all.names = TRUE), envir = environment())
```

```{r compute-eda, include=FALSE}
eda <- local({
# Original EDA source retained from STAT5003_group_project_RMarkdown_template_v29.Rmd.
# Complete calculations are included here in an isolated scope for report layout.

# Original EDA chunk 1: eda-data-quality, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE
library(lubridate)

# EDA audit helpers: inspect blanks and read date strings without changing the source.
is_blank <- function(x) {
  is.na(x) | trimws(as.character(x)) == ""
}

parse_shelter_date <- function(x) {
  as.Date(parse_date_time(
    as.character(x),
    orders = c("Y b d I M S p", "ymd HMS", "mdy HMS", "dmy HMS",
               "ymd", "mdy", "dmy"),
    locale = "C", tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE
  ))
}

# Keep this copy unchanged throughout EDA.
data_eda <- data_selected

# age check
age_audit <- tibble(
  DOB = parse_shelter_date(data_eda$Date.of.Birth),
  Intake_Date = parse_shelter_date(data_eda$Intake.Date)
) %>%
  mutate(Age_Years_raw = as.numeric(Intake_Date - DOB) / 365)

quality_features <- c(
  "Type", "Sex", "Spayed.Neutered", "Primary.Breed",
  "Primary.Color", "Secondary.Color", "Name", "Date.of.Birth", "Intake.Date"
)
quality_summary <- tibble(
  Feature = quality_features,
  Distinct_nonblank = sapply(quality_features, function(v) {
    x <- as.character(data_eda[[v]])
    n_distinct(x[!is_blank(x)])
  }),
  Missing_n = sapply(quality_features, function(v) sum(is_blank(data_eda[[v]]))),
  Missing_pct = 100 * Missing_n / nrow(data_eda),
  Unknown_label_n = sapply(quality_features, function(v) {
    sum(str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(data_eda[[v]]))) == "unknown",
        na.rm = TRUE)
  })
)
knitr::kable(quality_summary, digits = 2,
             caption = "Raw-field quality in the complete cat-and-dog subset")

quality_checks <- tibble(
  Check = c("Records", "Distinct nonmissing Animal IDs", "Exact duplicate rows",
            "Animal IDs with more than one record", "Missing Animal IDs",
            "Nonblank birth dates that failed parsing",
            "Nonblank intake dates that failed parsing",
            "Age unavailable from dates", "Negative ages observed"),
  Count = c(
    nrow(data_eda),
    n_distinct(data_eda$Animal.ID[!is_blank(data_eda$Animal.ID)]),
    sum(duplicated(data_eda)),
    sum(table(data_eda$Animal.ID[!is_blank(data_eda$Animal.ID)]) > 1),
    sum(is_blank(data_eda$Animal.ID)),
    sum(!is_blank(data_eda$Date.of.Birth) & is.na(age_audit$DOB)),
    sum(!is_blank(data_eda$Intake.Date) & is.na(age_audit$Intake_Date)),
    sum(is.na(age_audit$Age_Years_raw)),
    sum(age_audit$Age_Years_raw < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
knitr::kable(quality_checks, caption = "Record and date checks")

# Original EDA chunk 2: eda-plot-helpers
# These functions aggregate observed categories
outcome_colours <- setNames(
  c("#66C2A5", "#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB", "#E78AC3", "#A6D854"),
  levels(data_eda$Outcome.Group)
)

outcome_summary <- function(df, feature) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Level = as.character(.data[[feature]])) %>%
    select(Level, Outcome.Group) %>%
    count(Level, Outcome.Group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(Level) %>%
    mutate(Total = sum(n), Prop = n / Total) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Axis labels distinguish NA, blanks and whitespace without changing their values.
display_eda_level <- function(x) {
  labels <- as.character(x)
  labels[is.na(x)] <- "<NA>"
  labels[!is.na(x) & x == ""] <- "<blank>"
  whitespace <- !is.na(x) & x != "" & trimws(x) == ""
  labels[whitespace] <- "<whitespace>"
  labels
}

plot_outcome_summary <- function(summary, title) {
  totals <- distinct(summary, Level, Total)
  ggplot(summary, aes(x = Level, y = Prop, fill = Outcome.Group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
      paste0(display_eda_level(x), "\n(n=",
             scales::comma(totals$Total[match(x, totals$Level)]), ")")
    }) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colours, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Within-group proportion", fill = "Outcome") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
}

plot_outcome <- function(df, feature, title) {
  plot_outcome_summary(outcome_summary(df, feature), title)
}

plot_outcome_heatmap <- function(summary, title) {
  totals <- distinct(summary, Level, Total)
  ggplot(summary, aes(x = Outcome.Group, y = Level, fill = Prop)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = if_else(Prop >= 0.08, sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * Prop), "")),
              size = 3) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) {
      paste0(display_eda_level(x), " (n=",
             scales::comma(totals$Total[match(x, totals$Level)]), ")")
    }) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F0F4F8", high = "#1F78B4", labels = percent_format()) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Proportion") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
}

outcome_rate <- function(feature, level, outcome) {
  x <- outcome_summary(data_eda, feature)
  index <- !is.na(x$Level) & x$Level == level & x$Outcome.Group == outcome
  value <- x$Prop[index]
  if (length(value) == 0L) return("not observed")
  sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * value)
}

    ),
    Placeholder = sum(
      !is_blank(Name) &
        str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(Name))) %in%
          c("unknown", "*", "n/a", "na")
    ),
    Blank = sum(
      !is.na(Name) & trimws(as.character(Name)) == "",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Missing = sum(is.na(Name)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Outcome.Group, names_to = "Level", values_to = "n") %>%
  group_by(Level) %>%
  mutate(

    Prop = if_else(Total > 0, n / Total, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
```

```{r compute-logistic, include=FALSE}
# Complete multinomial logistic-regression workflow, evaluated in an isolated scope.
# All inputs come from the shared preprocessing already executed in this Rmd.
# Model results stay in memory; no external R scripts or saved result files are used.
lr_results <- local({
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(nnet)
    library(glmnet)
    library(splines)
  })
  x_train <- shared$x_train
  x_test <- shared$x_test
  y_train <- shared$y_train
  y_test <- shared$y_test
  train_raw <- shared$train_raw
  test_raw <- shared$test_raw
  cv_folds <- shared$cv_folds
  cv_data <- shared$cv_data
  data_features <- shared$data_features
  model_predictors <- shared$model_predictors
  factor_predictors <- shared$factor_predictors
  classes <- levels(y_train)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(x_train), !anyNA(x_test))
  set.seed(5003)

  # ---- design-helpers ----
  # Metrics used by the whole group: macro-F1 (primary), balanced accuracy, per-class recall.
  class_metrics <- function(truth, pred) {
    truth <- factor(truth, levels = classes); pred <- factor(pred, levels = classes)
    cm <- table(Truth = truth, Pred = pred)
    recall <- diag(cm) / rowSums(cm)
    precision <- ifelse(colSums(cm) > 0, diag(cm) / colSums(cm), 0)
    f1 <- ifelse(precision + recall > 0, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 0)
    list(cm = cm, recall = recall, precision = precision, f1 = f1,
         summary = c(macro_F1 = mean(f1), balanced_accuracy = mean(recall),
                     accuracy = sum(diag(cm)) / sum(cm)))
  }

  class_weights <- function(y) {
    w <- length(y) / (length(levels(y)) * as.numeric(table(y)))
    setNames(w, levels(y))[as.character(y)]
  }

  ref_levels <- function(x) {
    fixed <- c(Type = "Cat", Sex = "Female", has_pattern = "Pure", has_Name = "0")
    sapply(names(Filter(is.factor, x)), function(v) {
      if (v %in% names(fixed)) fixed[[v]] else names(which.max(table(x[[v]])))
    })
  }

  # Build train/new design matrices with rules learned from the training part only.
  # spec = "base": shared 8 predictors, linear standardised age.
  # spec = "extended": + ns(log1p(age), 3) + Dog x log-age + age_missing flag.
  build_design <- function(xtr, xnew, miss_tr, miss_new, spec = "base", drop = character(0)) {
    refs <- ref_levels(xtr)
    prep <- function(x) {
      for (v in names(refs)) x[[v]] <- relevel(factor(x[[v]], levels = levels(xtr[[v]])), refs[[v]])
      x[, setdiff(names(x), c("Age_Years_imputed", drop)), drop = FALSE]
    }
    ftr <- prep(xtr); fnew <- prep(xnew)
    mm <- function(f) model.matrix(~ ., data = f)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
    Xtr <- mm(ftr); Xnew <- mm(fnew)
    mu <- mean(xtr$Age_Years_imputed); s <- sd(xtr$Age_Years_imputed)
    if (spec == "base") {
      Xtr <- cbind(Xtr, age_z = (xtr$Age_Years_imputed - mu) / s)
      Xnew <- cbind(Xnew, age_z = (xnew$Age_Years_imputed - mu) / s)
    } else {
      la_tr <- log1p(xtr$Age_Years_imputed); la_new <- log1p(xnew$Age_Years_imputed)
      basis <- ns(la_tr, df = 3)
      B_tr <- basis; B_new <- predict(basis, la_new)
      colnames(B_tr) <- colnames(B_new) <- paste0("age_ns", 1:3)
      lm_ <- mean(la_tr); ls_ <- sd(la_tr)
      Xtr <- cbind(Xtr, unclass(B_tr)[, 1:3],
                   dog_x_logage = (xtr$Type == "Dog") * (la_tr - lm_) / ls_,
                   age_missing = as.numeric(miss_tr))
      Xnew <- cbind(Xnew, B_new,
                    dog_x_logage = (xnew$Type == "Dog") * (la_new - lm_) / ls_,
                    age_missing = as.numeric(miss_new))
    }
    colnames(Xtr) <- colnames(Xnew) <- make.names(colnames(Xtr))
    # Drop any column that is constant in training (zero variance).
    keep <- apply(Xtr, 2, function(z) length(unique(z)) > 1)
    list(Xtr = Xtr[, keep, drop = FALSE], Xnew = Xnew[, keep, drop = FALSE])
  }

  # Age missing flag (missing DOB or negative age), aligned to shared rows.
  miss_train <- is.na(train_raw$Age_Years)
  miss_test <- is.na(test_raw$Age_Years)
  fold_miss <- lapply(seq_along(cv_folds), function(k) list(
    tr = miss_train[-cv_folds[[k]]], va = miss_train[cv_folds[[k]]]))
  for (k in seq_along(cv_data)) {          # check alignment with the shared cv_data
    stopifnot(identical(cv_data[[k]]$y_valid, y_train[cv_folds[[k]]]))
  }

  # ---- collinearity ----
  X_base <- build_design(x_train, x_train, miss_train, miss_train, "base")$Xtr
  vif <- sapply(colnames(X_base), function(j) {
    r2 <- summary(lm(X_base[, j] ~ X_base[, -which(colnames(X_base) == j)]))$r.squared
    1 / (1 - r2)
  })
  vif_tab <- tibble(Column = names(vif), VIF = unname(vif)) %>% arrange(desc(VIF))

  fac <- names(Filter(is.factor, x_train))
  cramer <- outer(fac, fac, Vectorize(function(a, b) {
    t <- table(x_train[[a]], x_train[[b]])
    s <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(t, correct = FALSE)$statistic)
    sqrt(unname(s) / (sum(t) * (min(dim(t)) - 1)))
  }))
  dimnames(cramer) <- list(fac, fac)

  # ---- cv-models ----
  alphas <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
  n_lambda <- 40

  fit_multinom <- function(X, y, w = NULL) {
    df <- data.frame(X, .y = y)
    if (is.null(w)) w <- rep(1, length(y))
    multinom(.y ~ ., data = df, weights = w, maxit = 1000, MaxNWts = 10000, trace = FALSE)
  }
  pred_multinom <- function(fit, X) as.character(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(X), type = "class"))

  cv_rows <- list(); fold_rows <- list(); grid_rows <- list(); oof <- list()

  # Majority-class reference and plain multinomial models
  for (k in seq_along(cv_data)) {
    d <- cv_data[[k]]
    yva <- d$y_valid
    maj <- names(which.max(table(d$y_train)))
    m <- class_metrics(yva, rep(maj, length(yva)))
    fold_rows[[length(fold_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(Model = "Majority class", Fold = k, !!!as.list(m$summary),
                                                 !!!setNames(as.list(m$recall), paste0("recall_", classes)))
    des <- build_design(d$x_train, d$x_valid, fold_miss[[k]]$tr, fold_miss[[k]]$va, "base")
    for (mod in c("M0 multinom", "M1 multinom + weights")) {
      w <- if (mod == "M0 multinom") NULL else class_weights(d$y_train)
      fit <- fit_multinom(des$Xtr, d$y_train, w)
      m <- class_metrics(yva, pred_multinom(fit, des$Xnew))
      fold_rows[[length(fold_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(Model = mod, Fold = k, !!!as.list(m$summary),
                                                   !!!setNames(as.list(m$recall), paste0("recall_", classes)))
    }
  }

  # glmnet: shared lambda path per alpha from the full training data, then fold scores
  tune_glmnet <- function(spec) {
    full <- build_design(x_train, x_train, miss_train, miss_train, spec)
    res <- list()
    for (a in alphas) {
      path <- glmnet(full$Xtr, y_train, family = "multinomial", type.multinomial = "grouped",
                     alpha = a, weights = class_weights(y_train), nlambda = n_lambda,
                     lambda.min.ratio = 1e-4)$lambda
      for (k in seq_along(cv_data)) {
        d <- cv_data[[k]]
        des <- build_design(d$x_train, d$x_valid, fold_miss[[k]]$tr, fold_miss[[k]]$va, spec)
        fit <- glmnet(des$Xtr, d$y_train, family = "multinomial", type.multinomial = "grouped",
                      alpha = a, weights = class_weights(d$y_train), lambda = path)
        pr <- predict(fit, des$Xnew, type = "class")
        for (j in seq_along(path)) {
          m <- class_metrics(d$y_valid, pr[, j])
          res[[length(res) + 1]] <- tibble(spec = spec, alpha = a, lambda = path[j], Fold = k,
                                           !!!as.list(m$summary),
                                           !!!setNames(as.list(m$recall), paste0("recall_", classes)))
        }
      }
    }
    bind_rows(res)
  }
  grid <- bind_rows(tune_glmnet("base"), tune_glmnet("extended"))

  grid_summary <- grid %>% group_by(spec, alpha, lambda) %>%
    summarise(mean_macro_F1 = mean(macro_F1), se_macro_F1 = sd(macro_F1) / sqrt(n()),
              mean_bal_acc = mean(balanced_accuracy), .groups = "drop")

  pick_1se <- function(s) {
    best <- s[which.max(s$mean_macro_F1), ]
    cand <- s %>% filter(alpha == best$alpha, mean_macro_F1 >= best$mean_macro_F1 - best$se_macro_F1)
    list(best = best, one_se = cand[which.max(cand$lambda), ])
  }
  sel <- lapply(c(base = "base", extended = "extended"),
                function(sp) pick_1se(filter(grid_summary, spec == sp)))

  for (sp in names(sel)) {
    ch <- sel[[sp]]$one_se
    rows <- grid %>% filter(spec == sp, alpha == ch$alpha, lambda == ch$lambda) %>%
      mutate(Model = if (sp == "base") "M2 glmnet + weights" else "M3 glmnet + weights + age features") %>%
      select(Model, Fold, macro_F1, balanced_accuracy, accuracy, starts_with("recall_"))
    fold_rows[[length(fold_rows) + 1]] <- rows
  }
  fold_metrics <- bind_rows(fold_rows)

  cv_summary <- fold_metrics %>% group_by(Model) %>%
    summarise(macro_F1_sd = sd(macro_F1),
              across(c(macro_F1, balanced_accuracy, accuracy, starts_with("recall_")), mean),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    relocate(macro_F1_sd, .after = macro_F1) %>% arrange(desc(macro_F1))

  tuned_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(sel), function(sp) bind_rows(
    mutate(sel[[sp]]$best, rule = "best (lambda.min)"),
    mutate(sel[[sp]]$one_se, rule = "1-SE (used)"))))

  # ---- tuning-plot ----
  p_tune <- ggplot(grid_summary, aes(x = log10(lambda), y = mean_macro_F1, colour = factor(alpha))) +
    geom_line() + facet_wrap(~ spec) +
    geom_vline(data = bind_rows(lapply(names(sel), function(sp) sel[[sp]]$one_se)),
               aes(xintercept = log10(lambda)), linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = expression(log[10](lambda)), y = "CV macro-F1", colour = expression(alpha),
         title = "Elastic-net tuning on the shared folds (dashed = 1-SE choice)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)

  # ---- choose-final ----
  lr_models <- cv_summary %>% filter(Model != "Majority class")
  final_name <- lr_models$Model[1]
  final_spec <- if (grepl("age features", final_name)) "extended" else "base"
  final_is_glmnet <- grepl("glmnet", final_name)
  final_weighted <- grepl("weights", final_name)
  final_alpha <- if (final_is_glmnet) sel[[final_spec]]$one_se$alpha else NA
  final_lambda <- if (final_is_glmnet) sel[[final_spec]]$one_se$lambda else NA

  # ---- final-fit ----
  fit_final <- function(xtr, ytr, xnew, mtr, mnew, drop = character(0)) {
    des <- build_design(xtr, xnew, mtr, mnew, final_spec, drop)
    w <- if (final_weighted) class_weights(ytr) else NULL
    if (final_is_glmnet) {
      fit <- glmnet(des$Xtr, ytr, family = "multinomial", type.multinomial = "grouped",
                    alpha = final_alpha, weights = w, lambda = final_lambda)
      prob <- predict(fit, des$Xnew, type = "response")[, , 1]
    } else {
      fit <- fit_multinom(des$Xtr, ytr, w)
      prob <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(des$Xnew), type = "probs")
    }
    list(fit = fit, prob = prob, pred = classes[max.col(prob, ties.method = "first")],
         cols = colnames(des$Xtr))
  }
  final <- fit_final(x_train, y_train, x_test, miss_train, miss_test)
  test_m <- class_metrics(y_test, final$pred)

  cv_final <- cv_summary %>% filter(Model == final_name)
  metrics_out <- bind_rows(
    tibble(Model = final_name, Evaluation = "5-fold CV (mean)", macro_F1 = cv_final$macro_F1,
           balanced_accuracy = cv_final$balanced_accuracy, accuracy = cv_final$accuracy,
           !!!as.list(unlist(cv_final[paste0("recall_", classes)]))),
    tibble(Model = final_name, Evaluation = "Held-out test (20%)", !!!as.list(test_m$summary),
           !!!setNames(as.list(test_m$recall), paste0("recall_", classes))))

  per_class <- tibble(Class = classes, n_test = as.numeric(table(y_test)),
                      Precision = test_m$precision, Recall = test_m$recall, F1 = test_m$f1)

  # ---- confusion-matrix ----
  cm_df <- as.data.frame(test_m$cm) %>% group_by(Truth) %>%
    mutate(Row_pct = Freq / sum(Freq)) %>% ungroup()
  p_cm <- ggplot(cm_df, aes(x = Pred, y = forcats::fct_rev(Truth), fill = Row_pct)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d\n(%.0f%%)", Freq, 100 * Row_pct)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F0F4F8", high = "#1F78B4", labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Actual", fill = "Row %",
         title = "Logistic regression – held-out test confusion matrix") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

  # ---- oof-predictions ----
  # Out-of-fold predictions of the chosen model (useful for the group comparison).
  oof_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(cv_data), function(k) {
    d <- cv_data[[k]]
    r <- fit_final(d$x_train, d$y_train, d$x_valid, fold_miss[[k]]$tr, fold_miss[[k]]$va)
    data.frame(train_row = cv_folds[[k]], Animal.ID = train_raw$Animal.ID[cv_folds[[k]]],
               Fold = k, truth = d$y_valid, pred = r$pred, round(r$prob, 5), check.names = FALSE)
  })) %>% arrange(train_row)

  # ---- odds-ratios ----
  des_or <- build_design(x_train, x_test, miss_train, miss_test, "base")
  X_or <- des_or$Xtr
  X_or[, "age_z"] <- x_train$Age_Years_imputed          # odds ratio per year of age
  colnames(X_or)[colnames(X_or) == "age_z"] <- "Age_years"
  fit_or <- fit_multinom(X_or, y_train)
  co <- coef(fit_or); se <- summary(fit_or)$standard.errors
  or_tab <- expand.grid(Outcome = rownames(co), Term = colnames(co), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(coef = co[cbind(Outcome, Term)], se = se[cbind(Outcome, Term)],
           OR = exp(coef), OR_low = exp(coef - 1.96 * se), OR_high = exp(coef + 1.96 * se),
           p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(coef / se))) %>%
    filter(Term != "(Intercept)") %>% arrange(Outcome, Term)

  # Likelihood-ratio test for dropping each predictor (overall contribution)
  drop_lr <- bind_rows(lapply(setdiff(names(x_train), character(0)), function(v) {
    cols <- if (v == "Age_Years_imputed") "Age_years" else grep(paste0("^", make.names(v)), colnames(X_or), value = TRUE)
    f0 <- fit_multinom(X_or[, setdiff(colnames(X_or), cols), drop = FALSE], y_train)
    lr <- deviance(f0) - deviance(fit_or); dfree <- length(cols) * (length(classes) - 1)
    tibble(Predictor = v, LR_chisq = lr, df = dfree, p_value = pchisq(lr, dfree, lower.tail = FALSE))
  })) %>% arrange(desc(LR_chisq))

  if (final_is_glmnet) {
    cf <- coef(final$fit)
    final_coef <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cf), function(cl) tibble(
      Outcome = cl, Term = rownames(cf[[cl]]), coef = as.numeric(cf[[cl]]))))
  } else {
    cf <- coef(final$fit)
    final_coef <- as.data.frame(as.table(cf)) %>% rename(Outcome = Var1, Term = Var2, coef = Freq)
  }
  if (final_is_glmnet) {
    zero_terms <- final_coef %>% filter(Term != "(Intercept)") %>% group_by(Term) %>%
      summarise(all_zero = all(coef == 0)) %>% filter(all_zero) %>% pull(Term)
  }

  # ---- or-plot ----
  p_or <- or_tab %>%
    mutate(Term = gsub("^primary\\.breed\\.group", "Breed: ", Term),
           Term = gsub("^Base_Color", "Colour: ", Term),
           Term = gsub("^Spayed\\.Neutered", "Spayed/Neutered: ", Term),
           Term = gsub("^has_pattern", "Pattern: ", Term)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = OR, y = Term)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = OR_low, xmax = OR_high), height = 0.2, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_point(size = 1.4, colour = "#1F78B4") +
    scale_x_log10() + facet_wrap(~ Outcome, nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = "Odds ratio vs Adoption (log scale, 95% CI)", y = NULL,
         title = "Multinomial LR odds ratios (reference outcome = Adoption)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

  # ---- or-highlights ----
  key_terms <- c("TypeDog", "Age_years", "has_Name1", "Spayed.NeuteredNo", "Spayed.NeuteredUnknown",
                 "SexUnknown", "has_patternMixed")
  or_of <- function(term, out) sprintf("%.2f", or_tab$OR[or_tab$Term == term & or_tab$Outcome == out])

  # ---- sensitivity ----
  sens <- list()
  for (dr in list(c("Spayed.Neutered"), c("Spayed.Neutered", "has_Name"))) {
    sc <- sapply(seq_along(cv_data), function(k) {
      d <- cv_data[[k]]
      r <- fit_final(d$x_train, d$y_train, d$x_valid, fold_miss[[k]]$tr, fold_miss[[k]]$va, drop = dr)
      class_metrics(d$y_valid, r$pred)$summary
    })
    sens[[length(sens) + 1]] <- tibble(Check = paste("CV without", paste(dr, collapse = " + ")),
                                       !!!as.list(rowMeans(sc)))
  }

  # Temporal hold-out: reapply the shared training-only rules (steps 8-10).
  apply_shared_rules <- function(tr, new) {
    med_all <- median(tr$Age_Years, na.rm = TRUE)
    meds <- tr %>% group_by(Type) %>% summarise(Age_Median = median(Age_Years, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    top8 <- tr %>% filter(Primary.Breed != "Unknown") %>% count(Primary.Breed, name = "Count") %>%
      arrange(desc(Count), Primary.Breed) %>% filter(row_number() <= 8) %>% pull(Primary.Breed)
    f <- function(df) df %>% left_join(meds, by = "Type") %>%
      mutate(Age_Years_imputed = case_when(!is.na(Age_Years) ~ Age_Years, !is.na(Age_Median) ~ Age_Median,
                                           TRUE ~ med_all),
             primary.breed.group = if_else(Primary.Breed %in% top8, Primary.Breed, "Other")) %>%
      select(all_of(model_predictors))
    a <- f(tr); b <- f(new)
    for (v in factor_predictors) { a[[v]] <- factor(a[[v]]); b[[v]] <- factor(b[[v]], levels = levels(a[[v]])) }
    list(x_tr = a, x_new = b)
  }
  outcome_dt <- as.Date(lubridate::parse_date_time(as.character(data_features$Outcome.Date),
                        orders = c("mdy IMS p", "mdy HMS", "ymd HMS"), locale = "C", tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(outcome_dt))
  cut_date <- as.Date("2026-07-01")
  tr_t <- data_features[outcome_dt < cut_date, ]; te_t <- data_features[outcome_dt >= cut_date, ]
  sr <- apply_shared_rules(tr_t, te_t)
  ok <- complete.cases(sr$x_new)
  r_t <- fit_final(sr$x_tr, tr_t$Outcome.Group, sr$x_new[ok, ], is.na(tr_t$Age_Years), is.na(te_t$Age_Years)[ok])
  m_t <- class_metrics(te_t$Outcome.Group[ok], r_t$pred)
  sens[[length(sens) + 1]] <- tibble(Check = sprintf("Temporal hold-out (train n=%d, test n=%d, outcome >= %s)",
                                                     nrow(tr_t), sum(ok), cut_date), !!!as.list(m_t$summary))
  sens_tab <- bind_rows(tibble(Check = "Reference: chosen model, held-out test", !!!as.list(test_m$summary)),
                        tibble(Check = "Reference: chosen model, CV", macro_F1 = cv_final$macro_F1,
                               balanced_accuracy = cv_final$balanced_accuracy, accuracy = cv_final$accuracy),
                        bind_rows(sens))

  drift <- bind_rows(
    as.data.frame(prop.table(table(tr_t$Outcome.Group))) %>% mutate(Period = "Train (before cut-off)"),
    as.data.frame(prop.table(table(te_t$Outcome.Group))) %>% mutate(Period = "Test (after cut-off)")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Var1, values_from = Freq)

  # Retain all exported evidence from the original model workflow as objects.
  test_predictions <- data.frame(
    Animal.ID = test_raw$Animal.ID, truth = y_test, pred = final$pred,
    round(final$prob, 5), check.names = FALSE
  )
  list(
    cv_model_comparison = cv_summary,
    cv_fold_metrics = fold_metrics,
    cv_oof_predictions = oof_df,
    glmnet_tuning_grid = grid_summary,
    glmnet_tuning_fold_scores = grid,
    tuned_hyperparameters = tuned_tab,
    selected = list(name = final_name, specification = final_spec,
                    is_glmnet = final_is_glmnet, weighted = final_weighted,
                    alpha = final_alpha, lambda = final_lambda),
    metrics_summary = metrics_out,
    test_per_class = per_class,
    test_predictions = test_predictions,
    confusion_matrix_test = as.data.frame.matrix(test_m$cm),
    sensitivity_checks = sens_tab,
    temporal_class_distribution = drift,
    temporal_split = data.frame(
      Cut_date = cut_date, Training_rows = nrow(tr_t),
      Test_rows = nrow(te_t), Evaluated_test_rows = sum(ok),
      Excluded_test_rows = sum(!ok)
    ),
    vif_base_design = vif_tab,
    cramer_v = cramer,
    odds_ratios_vs_adoption = or_tab,
    drop1_likelihood_ratio = drop_lr,
    final_model_coefficients = final_coef,
    all_zero_terms = if (final_is_glmnet) zero_terms else character(0),
    plots = list(tuning_curve = p_tune, confusion_matrix = p_cm,
                 odds_ratios = p_or),
    final_model = final$fit,
    odds_ratio_model = fit_or
  )
})
```

```{r compute-random-forest, include=FALSE}
rf_results <- local({
  # Start from the shared preprocessing RNG state, independently of chunk order.
  if (!is.null(shared$rng_state))
    assign(".Random.seed", shared$rng_state, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(ranger)
  })
  cv_data <- shared$cv_data
  cv_folds <- shared$cv_folds
  y_train <- shared$y_train
  x_train <- shared$x_train
  y_test <- shared$y_test
  x_test <- shared$x_test
  stopifnot(length(cv_data) == 5L)

  # Retain every analysis output in memory for the report tables and checks.
  results <- list()
  keep_result <- function(x, name) {
    results[[sub("\\.csv$", "", name)]] <<- x
    invisible(x)
  }

  # Original member baseline: default ranger settings, fitted on full training.
  # This held-out result is descriptive; it is not used to select the CV grid.
  rf_baseline <- ranger(x = x_train, y = y_train, seed = 5003)
  rf_baseline_pred <- predict(rf_baseline, data = x_test)$predictions
  rf_baseline_recall <- rf_baseline_f1 <- numeric(length(levels(y_test)))
  names(rf_baseline_recall) <- names(rf_baseline_f1) <- levels(y_test)
  for (class in levels(y_test)) {
    actual_count <- sum(y_test == class)
    predicted_count <- sum(rf_baseline_pred == class)
    correct_count <- sum(y_test == class & rf_baseline_pred == class)
    rf_baseline_recall[class] <- correct_count / actual_count
    rf_baseline_f1[class] <- 2 * correct_count / (actual_count + predicted_count)
  }
  keep_result(data.frame(
    Model = "Baseline RF", Macro_F1 = mean(rf_baseline_f1),
    Balanced_Accuracy = mean(rf_baseline_recall), Accuracy = mean(rf_baseline_pred == y_test)
  ), "rf_baseline_holdout_metrics.csv")
  keep_result(data.frame(Test_Row = seq_along(y_test), Actual = as.character(y_test),
                         Predicted = as.character(rf_baseline_pred)),
              "rf_baseline_holdout_predictions.csv")
  rm(rf_baseline)

  # ---- RF CV (Daun grid on shared folds) ----
  macro_f1 <- function(actual, predicted) {
    classes <- levels(actual)
    mean(sapply(classes, function(cl) {
      tp <- sum(actual == cl & predicted == cl)
      pred_n <- sum(predicted == cl)
      act_n <- sum(actual == cl)
      if (act_n + pred_n == 0) return(0)
      2 * tp / (act_n + pred_n)
    }))
  }
  bal_acc <- function(actual, predicted) {
    classes <- levels(actual)
    mean(sapply(classes, function(cl) {
      act_n <- sum(actual == cl)
      if (act_n == 0) return(NA_real_)
      sum(actual == cl & predicted == cl) / act_n
    }), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  rf_grid <- expand.grid(num.trees = c(100, 300, 500), mtry = c(2, 4, 8))
  rf_cv_results <- data.frame()
  candidate_predictions <- vector("list", nrow(rf_grid))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rf_grid))) {
    candidate_predictions[[i]] <- vector("list", length(cv_data))
    for (k in seq_along(cv_data)) {
      fold <- cv_data[[k]]
      rf_model <- ranger(
        x = fold$x_train, y = fold$y_train,
        num.trees = rf_grid$num.trees[i],
        mtry = rf_grid$mtry[i], seed = 5003 + k
      )
      preds <- predict(rf_model, data = fold$x_valid)$predictions
      candidate_predictions[[i]][[k]] <- preds
      rf_cv_results <- rbind(rf_cv_results, data.frame(
        num.trees = rf_grid$num.trees[i], mtry = rf_grid$mtry[i],
        Fold = k,
        Macro_F1 = macro_f1(fold$y_valid, preds),
        Balanced_Accuracy = bal_acc(fold$y_valid, preds),
        Accuracy = mean(preds == fold$y_valid)
      ))
    }
    message(sprintf("Random forest grid %d/%d complete", i, nrow(rf_grid)))
  }

  rf_cv_summary <- rf_cv_results %>%
    group_by(num.trees, mtry) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Macro_F1 = mean(Macro_F1),
      SD_Macro_F1 = sd(Macro_F1),
      Mean_Balanced_Accuracy = mean(Balanced_Accuracy),
      Mean_Accuracy = mean(Accuracy),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Mean_Macro_F1))

  keep_result(rf_cv_results, "rf_cv_fold_scores.csv")
  keep_result(rf_cv_summary, "rf_cv_summary.csv")

  rf_best <- rf_cv_summary[1, ]
  selected_index <- which(rf_grid$num.trees == rf_best$num.trees &
                            rf_grid$mtry == rf_best$mtry)
  # Keep exactly the predictions used to score the selected grid candidate.
  # A second prediction call can break tied class votes differently.
  best_preds <- candidate_predictions[[selected_index]]
  best_actual <- lapply(cv_data, `[[`, "y_valid")
  actual <- factor(unlist(best_actual), levels = levels(y_train))
  predicted <- factor(unlist(best_preds), levels = levels(y_train))
  per_class <- bind_rows(lapply(levels(actual), function(cl) {
    tp <- sum(actual == cl & predicted == cl)
    fp <- sum(actual != cl & predicted == cl)
    fn <- sum(actual == cl & predicted != cl)
    prec <- ifelse(tp + fp == 0, 0, tp / (tp + fp))
    rec <- ifelse(tp + fn == 0, 0, tp / (tp + fn))
    f1 <- ifelse(prec + rec == 0, 0, 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec))
    data.frame(Class = cl, Support = sum(actual == cl), Precision = prec, Recall = rec, F1 = f1)
  }))
  keep_result(per_class, "rf_oof_per_class.csv")
  pooled <- data.frame(
    Model = "Random Forest (CV-selected)",
    Macro_F1_pooled_oof = mean(per_class$F1),
    Balanced_Accuracy_pooled_oof = mean(per_class$Recall),
    Accuracy_pooled_oof = mean(actual == predicted),
    Mean_CV_Macro_F1 = rf_best$Mean_Macro_F1,
    SD_CV_Macro_F1 = rf_best$SD_Macro_F1,
    Mean_CV_Balanced_Accuracy = rf_best$Mean_Balanced_Accuracy,
    num.trees = rf_best$num.trees,
    mtry = rf_best$mtry
  )
  keep_result(pooled, "rf_selected_metrics.csv")


  # Reconstruct row-aligned predictions so all models can be verified together.
  oof_pred <- rep(NA_character_, length(y_train))
  fold_id <- integer(length(y_train))
  for (k in seq_along(cv_folds)) {
    oof_pred[cv_folds[[k]]] <- as.character(best_preds[[k]])
    fold_id[cv_folds[[k]]] <- k
  }
  stopifnot(!anyNA(oof_pred))
  keep_result(data.frame(Training_Row = seq_along(y_train),
                         Actual = as.character(y_train), Predicted = oof_pred,
                         Fold = fold_id), "rf_selected_oof_predictions.csv")
  results
})
```

```{r compute-svm, include=FALSE}
# Complete RBF SVM workflow, evaluated within this R Markdown document.
# Uses the shared training partition and training-only CV folds prepared above.
# Baseline, all 18 tuning candidates, weighted comparison and full-training
# refit are recomputed. No saved result files or external scripts are read.
svm_results <- local({
  stopifnot(is.environment(shared))
  if (!requireNamespace("e1071", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The SVM workflow requires the e1071 package.")
  }

  svm_metrics <- function(truth, prediction, classes = levels(truth)) {
    stopifnot(length(truth) == length(prediction), length(truth) > 0L,
              !anyNA(truth), !anyNA(prediction),
              all(as.character(truth) %in% classes),
              all(as.character(prediction) %in% classes))
    cm <- table(Actual = factor(truth, levels = classes),
                Predicted = factor(prediction, levels = classes))
    tp <- diag(cm)
    support <- rowSums(cm)
    predicted_n <- colSums(cm)
    recall <- ifelse(support > 0, tp / support, 0)
    precision <- ifelse(predicted_n > 0, tp / predicted_n, 0)
    # This also handles a class that the classifier never predicts.
    f1 <- ifelse(support + predicted_n > 0, 2 * tp / (support + predicted_n), 0)
    per_class <- data.frame(Class = classes, Support = as.integer(support),
                            Precision = as.numeric(precision),
                            Recall = as.numeric(recall), F1 = as.numeric(f1))
    list(summary = data.frame(Macro_F1 = mean(f1),
                              Balanced_Accuracy = mean(recall),
                              Accuracy = sum(tp) / sum(cm)),
         per_class = per_class, confusion = cm)
  }

  svm_fit_encoder <- function(x) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x)
    age <- "Age_Years_imputed"
    stopifnot(age %in% names(x), !anyNA(x), all(is.finite(x[[age]])))
    categorical <- setdiff(names(x), age)
    encoder <- list(predictors = names(x), age = age, categorical = categorical,
                    levels = lapply(x[categorical], function(z) sort(unique(as.character(z)))),
                    age_mean = mean(x[[age]]), age_sd = sd(x[[age]]), keep = NULL)
    if (!is.finite(encoder$age_sd) || encoder$age_sd == 0) encoder$age_sd <- 1
    encoded <- svm_apply_encoder(encoder, x)
    # Determine constants using this training partition only.
    encoder$keep <- apply(encoded, 2, function(z) length(unique(z)) > 1L)
    stopifnot(any(encoder$keep))
    encoder
  }

  svm_apply_encoder <- function(encoder, x) {
    stopifnot(all(encoder$predictors %in% names(x)))
    x <- as.data.frame(x)[encoder$predictors]
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(x[[encoder$age]])))
    blocks <- lapply(encoder$categorical, function(variable) {
      value <- as.character(x[[variable]])
      lev <- encoder$levels[[variable]]
      mat <- vapply(lev, function(z) as.numeric(!is.na(value) & value == z),
                    numeric(nrow(x)))
      mat <- matrix(mat, nrow = nrow(x), ncol = length(lev))
      colnames(mat) <- paste(variable, lev, sep = "=")
      mat
    })
    encoded <- do.call(cbind, c(blocks, list(
      Age_Years_imputed = (x[[encoder$age]] - encoder$age_mean) / encoder$age_sd
    )))
    colnames(encoded)[ncol(encoded)] <- encoder$age
    storage.mode(encoded) <- "double"
    if (!is.null(encoder$keep)) encoded <- encoded[, encoder$keep, drop = FALSE]
    # Assessment-only/unseen categories (including common-preprocessing NAs)
    # have an all-zero block rather than dropping the animal's row.
    stopifnot(nrow(encoded) == nrow(x), all(is.finite(encoded)))
    encoded
  }

  svm_class_weights <- function(y, weighting) {
    if (weighting == "none") return(NULL)
    freq <- table(y)
    stopifnot(all(freq > 0))
    # Mean observation weight is 1, keeping the C comparison interpretable.
    setNames(length(y) / (length(freq) * as.numeric(freq)), names(freq))
  }

  svm_train <- function(x, y, cost, gamma_multiplier, weighting) {
    e1071::svm(x = x, y = y, type = "C-classification", kernel = "radial",
               cost = cost, gamma = gamma_multiplier / ncol(x), scale = FALSE,
               class.weights = svm_class_weights(y, weighting),
               probability = FALSE, fitted = FALSE, cachesize = 256)
  }

  svm_predict <- function(bundle, newdata) {
    predict(bundle$model, svm_apply_encoder(bundle$encoder, newdata))
  }

  svm_run_cv <- function(cv_data, cv_folds, x_train, y_train) {
    stopifnot(length(cv_data) == 5L, length(cv_folds) == 5L,
              nrow(x_train) == length(y_train), !anyNA(x_train), !anyNA(y_train))
    classes <- levels(y_train)
    stopifnot(length(classes) == 5L,
              identical(sort(as.integer(unlist(cv_folds))), seq_along(y_train)))
    # Baseline = C=1, gamma=1/p, no class weights. It is one grid candidate.
    grid <- expand.grid(C = c(0.1, 1, 10), Gamma_multiplier = c(0.25, 1, 4),
                         Weighting = c("none", "inverse"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    grid$Candidate <- seq_len(nrow(grid))
    baseline_id <- grid$Candidate[grid$C == 1 & grid$Gamma_multiplier == 1 &
                                  grid$Weighting == "none"]
    prepared <- lapply(seq_along(cv_data), function(k) {
      fold <- cv_data[[k]]
      stopifnot(identical(as.character(fold$y_valid),
                          as.character(y_train[cv_folds[[k]]])),
                nrow(fold$x_train) + nrow(fold$x_valid) == length(y_train),
                all(table(fold$y_train) > 0), all(table(fold$y_valid) > 0))
      encoder <- svm_fit_encoder(fold$x_train)
      list(x_train = svm_apply_encoder(encoder, fold$x_train),
           x_valid = svm_apply_encoder(encoder, fold$x_valid),
           y_train = fold$y_train, y_valid = fold$y_valid,
           encoder = encoder)
    })
    # Independent parameter candidates can run in local R worker processes.
    # Default is sequential; set options(stat5003.svm.workers = 3L) before rendering
    # to run up to three parameter candidates at once.
    workers <- max(1L, min(3L, as.integer(getOption("stat5003.svm.workers", 1L))))
    run_candidate <- function(i) {
      candidate <- grid[i, ]
      scores <- vector("list", length(prepared))
      fold_predictions <- vector("list", length(prepared))
      for (k in seq_along(prepared)) {
        fold <- prepared[[k]]
        t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
        model <- svm_train(fold$x_train, fold$y_train, candidate$C,
                           candidate$Gamma_multiplier, candidate$Weighting)
        pred <- predict(model, fold$x_valid)
        metric <- svm_metrics(fold$y_valid, pred, classes)$summary
        scores[[k]] <- cbind(
          candidate, Fold = k, Gamma = candidate$Gamma_multiplier / ncol(fold$x_train),
          Encoded_predictors = ncol(fold$x_train), metric,
          Support_vectors = model$tot.nSV,
          Seconds = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
        )
        fold_predictions[[k]] <- data.frame(
          Row = cv_folds[[k]], Fold = k, Actual = as.character(fold$y_valid),
          Predicted = as.character(pred), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        progress <- sprintf("SVM %02d/%02d fold %d/5: C=%g gamma=%g/%d %s; macro-F1=%.4f (%.1fs)",
                        i, nrow(grid), k, candidate$C, candidate$Gamma_multiplier,
                        ncol(fold$x_train), candidate$Weighting, metric$Macro_F1,
                        proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0)
        message(progress)
      }
      result <- list(scores = do.call(rbind, scores), predictions = do.call(rbind, fold_predictions))
      result
    }
    if (workers > 1L) {
      cluster <- parallel::makePSOCKcluster(workers)
      on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cluster), add = TRUE)
      parallel::clusterCall(cluster, function(paths) .libPaths(paths), .libPaths())
      # Give workers an explicit, small scope. This prevents the enclosing
      # knitting environment (and other fitted models) from being serialised.
      worker_scope <- list2env(
        list(grid = grid, prepared = prepared, classes = classes, cv_folds = cv_folds),
        parent = globalenv()
      )
      worker_scope$svm_train <- svm_train
      worker_scope$svm_class_weights <- svm_class_weights
      worker_scope$svm_metrics <- svm_metrics
      for (helper in c("svm_train", "svm_class_weights", "svm_metrics")) {
        environment(worker_scope[[helper]]) <- worker_scope
      }
      worker_task <- run_candidate
      environment(worker_task) <- worker_scope
      candidate_results <- parallel::parLapplyLB(
        cluster, seq_len(nrow(grid)), worker_task
      )
    } else {
      candidate_results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), run_candidate)
    }
    predictions <- lapply(candidate_results, `[[`, "predictions")
    fold_scores <- do.call(rbind, lapply(candidate_results, `[[`, "scores"))
    tuning <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
      z <- fold_scores[fold_scores$Candidate == i, ]
      cbind(grid[i, ], Mean_Macro_F1 = mean(z$Macro_F1), SD_Macro_F1 = sd(z$Macro_F1),
            Mean_Balanced_Accuracy = mean(z$Balanced_Accuracy),
            Mean_Accuracy = mean(z$Accuracy), Total_seconds = sum(z$Seconds))
    }))
    tuning <- tuning[order(-tuning$Mean_Macro_F1, tuning$SD_Macro_F1,
                           tuning$C, tuning$Gamma_multiplier, tuning$Weighting), ]
    rownames(tuning) <- NULL
    best <- tuning[1, ]
    baseline <- tuning[tuning$Candidate == baseline_id, ]
    selected_oof <- predictions[[best$Candidate]]
    selected_oof <- selected_oof[order(selected_oof$Row), ]
    baseline_oof <- predictions[[baseline_id]]
    baseline_oof <- baseline_oof[order(baseline_oof$Row), ]
    stopifnot(identical(as.integer(selected_oof$Row), seq_along(y_train)),
              identical(as.character(y_train), selected_oof$Actual))
    oof_metrics <- svm_metrics(selected_oof$Actual, selected_oof$Predicted, classes)
    best_weighted <- tuning[tuning$Weighting == "inverse", ][1, ]
    weighted_oof <- predictions[[best_weighted$Candidate]]
    weighted_metrics <- svm_metrics(weighted_oof$Actual, weighted_oof$Predicted, classes)
    weighting_tradeoff <- rbind(
      cbind(Variant = "Selected by macro-F1", oof_metrics$per_class),
      cbind(Variant = "Best weighted SVM", weighted_metrics$per_class))
    # One stable comparison row per variant for the group-wide model table.
    comparison <- rbind(cbind(Model = "SVM baseline", baseline),
                         cbind(Model = "SVM selected by CV", best))
    encoder <- svm_fit_encoder(x_train)
    final_model <- svm_train(svm_apply_encoder(encoder, x_train), y_train,
                             best$C, best$Gamma_multiplier, best$Weighting)
    bundle <- list(model = final_model, encoder = encoder, best = best,
                    class_levels = classes,
                    note = "Training-only refit. Holdout has NOT been evaluated.")
    list(tuning = tuning, fold_scores = fold_scores, comparison = comparison,
         selected_oof = selected_oof, baseline_oof = baseline_oof,
         oof = oof_metrics, bundle = bundle,
         best_weighted = best_weighted, weighting_tradeoff = weighting_tradeoff,
         weighted_oof = weighted_oof, weighted_metrics = weighted_metrics)
  }

  svm_plot_results <- function(result) {
    if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) return(invisible(NULL))
    tuning_plot <- result$tuning
    tuning_plot$Text_colour <- ifelse(
      tuning_plot$Mean_Macro_F1 > mean(range(tuning_plot$Mean_Macro_F1)), "white", "#17324d")
    p_tuning <- ggplot2::ggplot(tuning_plot, ggplot2::aes(
      x = factor(C), y = factor(Gamma_multiplier), fill = Mean_Macro_F1)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile(colour = "white") +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Mean_Macro_F1), colour = Text_colour), size = 5) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_identity() +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ Weighting) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "#e8f3fa", high = "#12648a") +
      ggplot2::labs(title = "SVM tuning: mean macro-F1 across shared five-fold CV",
                     x = "Cost (C)", y = "Gamma multiplier (gamma = multiplier / p)", fill = "Macro-F1") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + ggplot2::theme(
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(14, 18, 14, 14),
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13))
    cm <- as.data.frame(result$oof$confusion)
    cm$Within_actual <- cm$Freq / rowSums(result$oof$confusion)[match(cm$Actual, rownames(result$oof$confusion))]
    cm$Text_colour <- ifelse(cm$Within_actual > 0.5, "white", "#17324d")
    p_cm <- ggplot2::ggplot(cm, ggplot2::aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Within_actual)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile(colour = "white") +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf("%d\n%.1f%%", Freq, 100 * Within_actual), colour = Text_colour), size = 3.5) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_identity() +
      ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(result$oof$per_class$Class)) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef4f8", high = "#12648a", limits = c(0, 1)) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = "Selected SVM: cross-validation confusion matrix",
                     subtitle = "Out-of-fold predictions; same folds used for tuning",
                     fill = "Row share") + ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(14, 18, 14, 14),
                      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13),
                      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10))
    p_recall <- ggplot2::ggplot(result$oof$per_class, ggplot2::aes(x = Class, y = Recall)) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#12648a", width = 0.65) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * Recall)), vjust = -0.4) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
                                 labels = function(x) paste0(100 * x, "%")) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = "Which outcomes does SVM identify?", x = NULL, y = "Out-of-fold recall") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    invisible(list(tuning = p_tuning, confusion = p_cm, recall = p_recall))
  }


  result <- svm_run_cv(
    shared$cv_data, shared$cv_folds, shared$x_train, shared$y_train
  )
  result$plots <- svm_plot_results(result)

  # Flat result names match the tables formerly exported as separate CSVs.
  result$baseline_vs_selected <- result$comparison
  result$cv_fold_scores <- result$fold_scores
  result$tuning_summary <- result$tuning
  result$selected_oof_predictions <- result$selected_oof
  result$baseline_oof_predictions <- result$baseline_oof
  result$oof_per_class <- result$oof$per_class
  result$oof_pooled_metrics <- result$oof$summary
  result$oof_confusion_matrix <- as.data.frame.matrix(result$oof$confusion)
  result$best_weighted_cv <- result$best_weighted
  result$weighted_oof_predictions <- result$weighted_oof
  result$svm_training_refit <- result$bundle
  result$split_manifest <- data.frame(
    Animal_ID = c(shared$train_raw$Animal.ID, shared$test_raw$Animal.ID),
    Partition = c(rep("train", nrow(shared$train_raw)),
                  rep("test", nrow(shared$test_raw))),
    Row_in_partition = c(seq_len(nrow(shared$train_raw)),
                         seq_len(nrow(shared$test_raw)))
  )
  result$data_audit <- data.frame(
    Check = c("CSV rows", "Cat/dog rows", "Latest-intake animals",
              "Training rows", "Reserved test rows"),
    Count = c(nrow(shared$data), nrow(shared$data_selected),
              nrow(shared$data_latest), nrow(shared$x_train), nrow(shared$x_test))
  )
  result$metric_definitions <- c(
    "Balanced_Accuracy is mean class recall.",
    "Mean_Macro_F1 is the unweighted mean of five fold macro-F1 scores; SD is their sample standard deviation.",
    "Pooled OOF metrics pool all validation-fold predictions and can differ from fold means.",
    "Selection maximises mean CV macro-F1 across 18 candidates (90 fits).",
    "The same folds are used for tuning and reporting, so selected CV performance is a development estimate.",
    "No test predictors or labels are used for fitting, tuning or selection; the test set is not scored for SVM.",
    "The final SVM and its encoder are refitted on the complete training partition."
  )
  result$session_info <- utils::sessionInfo()
  result
})
```

```{r compute-xgboost, include=FALSE}
xgb_results <- local({
  # Start from the shared preprocessing RNG state, independently of chunk order.
  if (!is.null(shared$rng_state))
    assign(".Random.seed", shared$rng_state, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(caret)
    library(xgboost)
  })
  x_train <- shared$x_train
  x_test <- shared$x_test
  y_train <- shared$y_train
  y_test <- shared$y_test
  cv_data <- shared$cv_data
  cv_folds <- shared$cv_folds
  model_predictors <- shared$model_predictors
  fold_id <- integer(length(y_train))
  for (k in seq_along(cv_folds)) fold_id[cv_folds[[k]]] <- k
  stopifnot(all(fold_id %in% seq_along(cv_folds)),
            !anyDuplicated(unlist(cv_folds)),
            length(unlist(cv_folds)) == length(y_train))

  # Retain every analysis output in memory for the report tables and checks.
  results <- list()
  keep_result <- function(x, name) {
    results[[sub("\\.csv$", "", name)]] <<- x
    invisible(x)
  }

  outcome_levels <- levels(y_train)
  n_classes <- length(outcome_levels)
  xgb_seed <- 5003L
  xgb_nrounds <- 150L
  stopifnot(n_classes == 5L, identical(levels(y_test), outcome_levels), length(cv_data) == 5L)

  class_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {
    actual <- factor(actual, levels = outcome_levels)
    predicted <- factor(predicted, levels = outcome_levels)
    stopifnot(length(actual) == length(predicted), !anyNA(actual), !anyNA(predicted))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(outcome_levels, function(cl) {
      tp <- sum(actual == cl & predicted == cl)
      fp <- sum(actual != cl & predicted == cl)
      fn <- sum(actual == cl & predicted != cl)
      precision <- if (tp + fp > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else 0
      recall <- if (tp + fn > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else 0
      f1 <- if (precision + recall > 0) 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) else 0
      data.frame(Class = cl, Support = sum(actual == cl), Precision = precision,
                 Recall = recall, F1 = f1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }
  score_predictions <- function(actual, predicted) {
    pc <- class_metrics(actual, predicted)
    data.frame(Macro_F1 = mean(pc$F1), Balanced_Accuracy = mean(pc$Recall),
               Accuracy = mean(as.character(actual) == as.character(predicted)),
               Weighted_F1 = weighted.mean(pc$F1, pc$Support))
  }
  confusion_table <- function(actual, predicted) {
    tab <- table(Actual = factor(actual, levels = outcome_levels),
                 Predicted = factor(predicted, levels = outcome_levels))
    data.frame(Actual = rownames(tab), as.data.frame.matrix(tab), row.names = NULL,
               check.names = FALSE)
  }

  encode_fold <- function(train, valid) {
    encoder <- caret::dummyVars(~ ., data = train, fullRank = FALSE)
    train_matrix <- as.matrix(predict(encoder, newdata = train))
    valid_matrix <- as.matrix(predict(encoder, newdata = valid))
    storage.mode(train_matrix) <- storage.mode(valid_matrix) <- "double"
    stopifnot(identical(colnames(train_matrix), colnames(valid_matrix)),
              !anyNA(train_matrix), !anyNA(valid_matrix))
    list(train = train_matrix, valid = valid_matrix)
  }

  make_matrices <- function(train_x, train_y, valid_x, valid_y) {
    encoded <- encode_fold(train_x, valid_x)
    counts <- table(train_y)
    class_weights <- length(train_y) / (n_classes * counts)
    weights <- as.numeric(class_weights[as.character(train_y)])
    list(
      unweighted = xgb.DMatrix(encoded$train, label = as.integer(train_y) - 1L),
      weighted = xgb.DMatrix(encoded$train, label = as.integer(train_y) - 1L, weight = weights),
      valid = xgb.DMatrix(encoded$valid, label = as.integer(valid_y) - 1L),
      train_y = train_y, valid_y = valid_y, feature_names = colnames(encoded$train)
    )
  }
  cv_matrices <- lapply(cv_data, function(d) make_matrices(d$x_train, d$y_train, d$x_valid, d$y_valid))

  # In R xgboost 1.x, reshape=TRUE requests an observation-by-class matrix.
  # Recent versions return this matrix directly for multiclass predictions.
  predict_classes <- function(model, dmat, expected_n) {
    p <- if (utils::packageVersion("xgboost") < "3.0.0") {
      predict(model, dmat, reshape = TRUE)
    } else {
      predict(model, dmat)
    }
    if (is.null(dim(p))) p <- matrix(p, ncol = n_classes, byrow = TRUE)
    if (nrow(p) == n_classes && ncol(p) == expected_n && expected_n != n_classes) p <- t(p)
    stopifnot(identical(dim(p), c(as.integer(expected_n), as.integer(n_classes))),
              all(is.finite(p)), all(abs(rowSums(p) - 1) < 1e-5))
    factor(outcome_levels[max.col(p, ties.method = "first")], levels = outcome_levels)
  }
  base_params <- list(booster = "gbtree", objective = "multi:softprob", num_class = n_classes,
                      eval_metric = "mlogloss", seed = xgb_seed, nthread = 2L)

  fit_config <- function(params, weighted, configuration, grid_id = NA_integer_) {
    rows <- vector("list", length(cv_data))
    oof_predictions <- rep(NA_character_, length(y_train))
    for (k in seq_along(cv_data)) {
      m <- cv_matrices[[k]]
      fit <- xgb.train(params = c(base_params, params),
                       data = if (weighted) m$weighted else m$unweighted,
                       nrounds = xgb_nrounds, verbose = 0)
      pred <- predict_classes(fit, m$valid, length(m$valid_y))
      oof_predictions[cv_folds[[k]]] <- as.character(pred)
      rows[[k]] <- cbind(data.frame(Configuration = configuration, Grid_ID = grid_id,
                                    Fold = k, nrounds = xgb_nrounds),
                         score_predictions(m$valid_y, pred))
    }
    stopifnot(!anyNA(oof_predictions))
    list(folds = do.call(rbind, rows), predictions = factor(oof_predictions, levels = outcome_levels))
  }
  summarise_folds <- function(folds) {
    data.frame(Mean_CV_Macro_F1 = mean(folds$Macro_F1), SD_CV_Macro_F1 = sd(folds$Macro_F1),
               Mean_CV_Balanced_Accuracy = mean(folds$Balanced_Accuracy),
               Mean_CV_Accuracy = mean(folds$Accuracy), Mean_CV_Weighted_F1 = mean(folds$Weighted_F1))
  }

  # A isolates ordinary XGBoost performance; A->B isolates the effect of weighting.
  default_params <- list(max_depth = 6L, eta = 0.3)
  A <- fit_config(default_params, FALSE, "A. Defaults, unweighted")
  message("Completed A: unweighted defaults")
  B <- fit_config(default_params, TRUE, "B. Defaults, balanced weights")
  message("Completed B: weighted defaults")

  tuning_grid <- expand.grid(max_depth = c(4L, 6L), eta = c(0.05, 0.10), subsample = 0.80,
                             colsample_bytree = c(0.70, 0.85), min_child_weight = c(1, 3),
                             KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  grid_fits <- vector("list", nrow(tuning_grid))
  grid_summaries <- vector("list", nrow(tuning_grid))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tuning_grid))) {
    grid_fits[[i]] <- fit_config(as.list(tuning_grid[i, ]), TRUE,
                                "C. Tuned, balanced weights", i)
    grid_summaries[[i]] <- cbind(data.frame(Grid_ID = i), tuning_grid[i, ],
                                summarise_folds(grid_fits[[i]]$folds))
    message(sprintf("Completed configuration %d/%d", i, nrow(tuning_grid)))
  }
  grid_summary <- do.call(rbind, grid_summaries)
  # The first configuration is retained if mean macro-F1 ties, matching the source analysis.
  best_index <- which.max(grid_summary$Mean_CV_Macro_F1)
  best_params <- as.list(tuning_grid[best_index, ])
  C <- grid_fits[[best_index]]
  configuration_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(list(A, B, C), function(x) {
    cbind(data.frame(Configuration = x$folds$Configuration[1L]), summarise_folds(x$folds))
  }))
  keep_result(configuration_summary, "xgb_configuration_summary.csv")
  keep_result(rbind(A$folds, B$folds, C$folds), "xgb_configuration_fold_scores.csv")
  keep_result(do.call(rbind, lapply(grid_fits, `[[`, "folds")), "xgb_grid_fold_scores.csv")
  keep_result(grid_summary, "xgb_grid_summary.csv")
  keep_result(C$folds, "xgb_selected_oof_fold_scores.csv")
  keep_result(data.frame(Training_Row = seq_along(y_train), Actual = as.character(y_train),
                           Predicted = as.character(C$predictions), Fold = fold_id), "xgb_selected_oof_predictions.csv")
  keep_result(class_metrics(y_train, C$predictions), "xgb_oof_per_class.csv")
  keep_result(confusion_table(y_train, C$predictions), "xgb_oof_confusion_matrix.csv")
  selected <- cbind(data.frame(Model = "XGBoost", nrounds = xgb_nrounds, seed = xgb_seed),
                    tuning_grid[best_index, ], summarise_folds(C$folds),
                    score_predictions(y_train, C$predictions))
  keep_result(selected, "xgb_selected_metrics.csv")

  # Majority baseline is selected within each training fold, then scored on its validation fold.
  majority_oof <- rep(NA_character_, length(y_train))
  majority_folds <- lapply(seq_along(cv_data), function(k) {
    d <- cv_data[[k]]
    majority <- names(which.max(table(d$y_train)))
    pred <- rep(majority, length(d$y_valid))
    majority_oof[cv_folds[[k]]] <<- pred
    cbind(data.frame(Fold = k, Majority_Class = majority), score_predictions(d$y_valid, pred))
  })
  majority_folds <- do.call(rbind, majority_folds)
  keep_result(majority_folds, "majority_cv_fold_scores.csv")
  keep_result(cbind(data.frame(Model = "Majority class"), summarise_folds(majority_folds)),
               "majority_cv_summary.csv")
  keep_result(class_metrics(y_train, majority_oof), "majority_oof_per_class.csv")

  # Holdout is scored after hyperparameter selection. It never determines parameters/rounds.
  full <- make_matrices(x_train, y_train, x_test, y_test)
  final_model <- xgb.train(params = c(base_params, best_params), data = full$weighted,
                           nrounds = xgb_nrounds, verbose = 0)
  holdout_pred <- predict_classes(final_model, full$valid, length(y_test))
  keep_result(cbind(data.frame(Model = "XGBoost", nrounds = xgb_nrounds),
                      score_predictions(y_test, holdout_pred)), "xgb_holdout_metrics.csv")
  keep_result(class_metrics(y_test, holdout_pred), "xgb_holdout_per_class.csv")
  keep_result(confusion_table(y_test, holdout_pred), "xgb_holdout_confusion_matrix.csv")
  keep_result(data.frame(Test_Row = seq_along(y_test), Actual = as.character(y_test),
                           Predicted = as.character(holdout_pred)), "xgb_holdout_predictions.csv")
  majority <- names(which.max(table(y_train)))
  keep_result(cbind(data.frame(Model = "Majority class", Majority_Class = majority),
                      score_predictions(y_test, rep(majority, length(y_test)))), "majority_holdout_metrics.csv")
  keep_result(cbind(data.frame(Majority_Class = majority),
                      score_predictions(y_train, rep(majority, length(y_train)))), "majority_training_metrics.csv")

  importance <- xgb.importance(feature_names = full$feature_names, model = final_model)
  importance_by_predictor <- data.frame(
    Predictor = model_predictors,
    Gain = vapply(model_predictors, function(p) {
      sum(importance$Gain[importance$Feature == p | startsWith(importance$Feature, paste0(p, "."))])
    }, numeric(1)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  importance_by_predictor <- importance_by_predictor[order(-importance_by_predictor$Gain), ]
  stopifnot(abs(sum(importance_by_predictor$Gain) - 1) < 1e-5)
  keep_result(importance_by_predictor, "xgb_feature_importance.csv")
  keep_result(as.data.frame(importance), "xgb_encoded_feature_importance.csv")
  keep_result(data.frame(Class = outcome_levels, Training = as.integer(table(y_train)),
                           Holdout = as.integer(table(y_test))), "split_class_counts.csv")

  results$final_model <- final_model
  results$protocol <- c(
    "150 boosting rounds for A/B/C and the final refit; no early stopping.",
    "Seed 5003, two threads, five shared stratified folds; training-only transforms and weights.",
    "Select the highest mean CV macro-F1; ties retain the first grid row.",
    "The existing holdout was examined in previous project versions.",
    paste("R", getRversion(), "; xgboost", utils::packageVersion("xgboost"))
  )
  results
})
```

```{r compute-decision-tree, include=FALSE}
dt_results <- local({
  # Start from the shared preprocessing RNG state, independently of chunk order.
  if (!is.null(shared$rng_state))
    assign(".Random.seed", shared$rng_state, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(rpart))

  # Retain every analysis output in memory for the report tables and checks.
  results <- list()
  keep_result <- function(x, name) {
    results[[sub("\\.csv$", "", name)]] <<- x
    invisible(x)
  }

  classes <- levels(shared$y_train)
  stopifnot(
    identical(classes,
              c("Adoption", "Transfer", "Return", "Euthanasia", "Other")),
    length(shared$cv_data) == 5L,
    nrow(shared$x_train) == length(shared$y_train),
    nrow(shared$x_test) == length(shared$y_test)
  )

  # Consistent metric definitions across all models.
  class_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {
    actual <- factor(actual, levels = classes)
    predicted <- factor(predicted, levels = classes)

    stopifnot(
      length(actual) == length(predicted),
      !anyNA(actual),
      !anyNA(predicted)
    )

    cm <- table(actual, predicted)
    tp <- diag(cm)
    support <- rowSums(cm)
    n_predicted <- colSums(cm)

    data.frame(
      Class = classes,
      Support = as.integer(support),
      Precision = ifelse(n_predicted > 0, tp / n_predicted, 0),
      Recall = ifelse(support > 0, tp / support, 0),
      F1 = ifelse(
        support + n_predicted > 0,
        2 * tp / (support + n_predicted),
        0
      ),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }

  metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {
    pc <- class_metrics(actual, predicted)

    c(
      Macro_F1 = mean(pc$F1),
      Balanced_Accuracy = mean(pc$Recall),
      Accuracy = mean(actual == predicted),
      Weighted_F1 = weighted.mean(pc$F1, pc$Support)
    )
  }

  # Train and predict one classification tree.
  fit_tree <- function(x_train, y_train, x_valid,
                       cp, maxdepth, minsplit) {
    train_df <- as.data.frame(x_train)
    train_df$Outcome.Group <- factor(y_train, levels = classes)

    model <- rpart::rpart(
      Outcome.Group ~ .,
      data = train_df,
      method = "class",
      control = rpart::rpart.control(
        cp = cp,
        maxdepth = maxdepth,
        minsplit = minsplit,
        xval = 0
      ),
      model = TRUE
    )

    valid_df <- as.data.frame(x_valid)

    # Preserve the outcome class order, including classes not predicted.
    predicted <- predict(model, newdata = valid_df, type = "class")
    predicted <- factor(as.character(predicted), levels = classes)

    list(model = model, predicted = predicted)
  }

  # A small, explicit complexity grid.
  # Larger cp values penalise additional splits; maxdepth limits tree depth.
  tree_grid <- expand.grid(
    cp = c(0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02),
    maxdepth = c(3L, 5L, 8L),
    minsplit = c(20L, 50L),
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Score every candidate on the same five training-only CV folds.
  grid_fold_rows <- list()
  candidate_predictions <- vector("list", nrow(tree_grid))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tree_grid))) {
    cfg <- tree_grid[i, ]
    candidate_predictions[[i]] <- vector("list", 5L)

    for (k in seq_len(5L)) {
      fold <- shared$cv_data[[k]]

      fitted <- fit_tree(
        x_train = fold$x_train,
        y_train = fold$y_train,
        x_valid = fold$x_valid,
        cp = cfg$cp,
        maxdepth = cfg$maxdepth,
        minsplit = cfg$minsplit
      )

      candidate_predictions[[i]][[k]] <- fitted$predicted
      fold_metrics <- metrics(fold$y_valid, fitted$predicted)

      grid_fold_rows[[length(grid_fold_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        Grid_ID = i,
        Fold = k,
        cp = cfg$cp,
        maxdepth = cfg$maxdepth,
        minsplit = cfg$minsplit,
        Macro_F1 = unname(fold_metrics["Macro_F1"]),
        Balanced_Accuracy = unname(fold_metrics["Balanced_Accuracy"]),
        Accuracy = unname(fold_metrics["Accuracy"]),
        Weighted_F1 = unname(fold_metrics["Weighted_F1"])
      )
    }
  }

  grid_fold_scores <- do.call(rbind, grid_fold_rows)

  grid_summary <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(split(grid_fold_scores, grid_fold_scores$Grid_ID), function(z) {
      data.frame(
```
